profile.headline: Platform / Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a determined platform engineer that loves meshing technology and innovation. I always make an extra effort to explore and master new technologies in this ever evolving landscape.
Throughout my career I've had the opportunity to explore and work with a large range of talented people. The teams I've collaborated range from large organizational teams to smaller more personal teams. 

My career has taken me from low level embedded software development for advanced avionic aircraft, all the way to platform engineering for startups. In both of these positions I've dove headfirst into new tech stacks to learn and allow the business to reach its desired goals.

My current toolbox includes embedded software development with C++ and software development with multiple versions of Python. I've had the opportunity to refine my DevOps skills with Groovy, Perl, Bash, Powershell, and Jenkins to create CI/CD pipelines from scratch. Additionally, I've utilized immutable infrastructure design principles to create / manage resources in AWS utilizing Chef, Ansible, and Terraform. I'm always eager to expand my existing toolset to learn about up and coming technologies. 

I'm available to connect and discuss new technologies and how my skills can create opportunities for collaboration. Feel free to reach out!

positions.title: Software Engineer II, Cloud Platform
positions.description: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Linux · Infrastructure as code (IaC)

positions.title: Platform Engineer II
positions.locationName: Fort Worth, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Designed and improved custom IaC tools to provision and standardize cloud resource provisioning.
Established patterns for provisioned resources to improve security, costs, and adaptability.
Effectively utilized Immutable Infrastructure design principles to create ECS resources.
Upgraded and maintained critical application infrastructure while reducing costs
Implemented strategic overhaul of legacy ElasticSearch and EC2 instances introducing modernized configurations that reduced costs by over 20%.
Debugged production errors utilizing cloud monitoring resources to reduce client impact
Effectively utilized monitoring tools to rapidly discover and address production issues.
Established incident reports and counter measures to prevent issues from occurring twice.
Led team retrospectives and organized resulting action items.
Took ownership of legacy infrastructure, making tactical and strategic improvements over time
Assisted in large scale codebase upgrades, including Java 8 EoL, node.js upgrades, Chef codebase migration to CINC, and Scala dependency updates
Orchestrated and delivered the platform migration from Amazon Linux 1 to Amazon Linux 2
Maintained platform security through code and system security patching
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Python (Programming Language) · Ansible · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Terraform · Jenkins · Groovy · Agile Methodologies · Splunk · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Linux · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · DevOps · Software Development · Chef

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Interacted directly with client to understand their needs / requirements to deliver multiple project capabilities. Ensured that project was completed correctly and on time by adhering to agile best practices. Collaborated with 3 additional engineers to understand scope and project deadlines to effectively prioritize the correct tasks.
Worked extensively within an RTOS environment that utilized multiple threads to ensure mission critical software could handle appropriate interrupts.
Created automated test development from scratch, utilizing PERL and Python to develop custom in house tools to revolutionize engineer productivity. Collaborated with a large teams of engineers to deliver robust Avionic Software.
Led drastic process migration from Waterfall practices to Agile, increasing software delivery cycles and adaptability.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Python (Programming Language) · Embedded Software · Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) · Leadership · Agile Methodologies · C++ · Software Project Management · DevOps · Pipelines

positions.title: Software Quality Operations Specialist at Adecco, onsite at Waymo
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Led automation and optimization of test review proceeds to quadruple the number of test reviewed each
week. Optimization allowed team increase weekly test reviews from 30 to 120.

Collaborated with a large team of engineers to communicate failures from test scenarios. Worked alongside teams of over 30+ people to triage over 200,000 integration tests each week to locate critical bugs for an autonomous vehicle.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) · Microsoft Excel · Teamwork

positions.title: Guest Service Team Leader
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Effectively scheduled multiple people concurrently to ensure priorities were completed on schedule.
Provided constructive feedback for managed people and prioritized tasks to maximize sales.
